#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

class Main {
public:
    void run() {
        int n, k;
        cin >> n >> k;
        
        vector<int> v(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int idx;
            cin >> idx;
            v[idx] = 1;
        }
        
        vector<int> ans = {1};
        int p = n / 2;
        while (true) {
            if ((p & 1) == 1) {
                ans = multiplyPolynomials(ans, v, MOD);
            }
            p >>= 1;
            if (p == 0) break;
            v = multiplyPolynomials(v, v, MOD);
        }
        
        long long res = 0;
        for (int x : ans) {
            res = (res + (long long)x * x) % MOD;
        }
        cout << res << endl;
    }
    
    vector<int> multiplyPolynomials(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
        int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
        int n = max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(need - 1)));
        
        vector<double> aReal(n, 0.0), aImag(n, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
            int x = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            aReal[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
            aImag[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        performFFT(aReal, aImag, false);
        
        vector<double> bReal(n, 0.0), bImag(n, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < b.size(); i++) {
            int x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            bReal[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
            bImag[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        performFFT(bReal, bImag, false);
        
        vector<double> resReal(n, 0.0), resImag(n, 0.0);
        vector<double> tmpReal(n, 0.0), tmpImag(n, 0.0);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
            
            double ar1 = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) * 0.5;
            double ai1 = (aImag[i] - aImag[j]) * 0.5;
            double ar2 = (aImag[i] + aImag[j]) * 0.5;
            double ai2 = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) * 0.5;
            
            double br1 = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) * 0.5;
            double bi1 = (bImag[i] - bImag[j]) * 0.5;
            double br2 = (bImag[i] + bImag[j]) * 0.5;
            double bi2 = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) * 0.5;
            
            resReal[i] = ar1 * br1 - ai1 * bi1 - ar2 * bi2 - ai2 * br2;
            resImag[i] = ar1 * bi1 + ai1 * br1 + ar2 * br2 - ai2 * bi2;
            tmpReal[i] = ar1 * br2 - ai1 * bi2 + ar2 * br1 - ai2 * bi1;
            tmpImag[i] = ar1 * bi2 + ai1 * br2 + ar2 * bi1 + ai2 * br1;
        }
        
        performFFT(resReal, resImag, true);
        performFFT(tmpReal, tmpImag, true);
        
        vector<int> result(need);
        for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
            long long aa = llround(resReal[i]);
            long long bb = llround(tmpReal[i]);
            long long cc = llround(resImag[i]);
            result[i] = (int)((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);
        }
        return result;
    }
    
    void performFFT(vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool inverse) {
        int n = re.size();
        if (n <= 1) return;
        
        vector<int> rev(n, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            rev[i] = (rev[i >> 1] >> 1) + ((i & 1) ? n / 2 : 0);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = rev[i];
            if (i < j) {
                swap(re[i], re[j]);
                swap(im[i], im[j]);
            }
        }
        
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            vector<double> cosTable(half), sinTable(half);
            double angleMult = inverse ? -1 : 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
                double angle = 2 * M_PI * i / len * angleMult;
                cosTable[i] = cos(angle);
                sinTable[i] = sin(angle);
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                    double wReal = cosTable[j];
                    double wImag = sinTable[j];
                    double uReal = re[i + j];
                    double uImag = im[i + j];
                    double vReal = re[i + j + half] * wReal - im[i + j + half] * wImag;
                    double vImag = re[i + j + half] * wImag + im[i + j + half] * wReal;
                    
                    re[i + j] = uReal + vReal;
                    im[i + j] = uImag + vImag;
                    re[i + j + half] = uReal - vReal;
                    im[i + j + half] = uImag - vImag;
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                re[i] /= n;
                im[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    Main mainInstance;
    mainInstance.run();
    return 0;
}
